about: Manifest cases both Battle BGM Makers run: port/tests/d012_tests.cpp (the game's rules, port/host/d012_mod_manifest.cpp, and the C++ tool's checks) and port/tools/bgm_maker/tests/test_manifest.py (the Python tool's validate). Each case is a manifest (or its text), the files to make (empty) in its folder, and other mods (their ids and track ids). Its problems are in order, notes left out; a message is given where both tools say the same.
